summary: Elevated 5xx surge after edge cache invalidations causing cold-shard reload amplification
description: Issue summary: Starting ~2026-03-13 11:05 UTC VeridianAI observed a sustained increase in 5xx responses from the Redwood API for tenant veridian-prod. Impact: ~8% error rate across short requests (10-200ms) with spikes to 25% for multi-shard prompts. Customer reports failures for chat completions and short-form generation. Environment: prod (us-east) on Dedicated pool D-12. Observed behavior: Error spike correlated with a burst of edge cache invalidations originating from a cache key eviction job; subsequent traffic routed to serving-runtime instances which performed cold shard reloads, causing model-manager lock contention and transient OOM/retry cascades in the runtime, exposing 502/503 and occasional 500s at the gateway. Steps to reproduce: 1) In a dedicated pool with sharded model placement, perform coordinated edge cache invalidations for a set of hot prefixes. 2) Immediately send multi-tenant mixed-size requests that touch shards across hosts. 3) Observe connection resets and 5xx responses while model shards reload. Logs and metrics: See snippets below and linked dashboards. Observed increased model-load duration from ~150ms to 2.5s, KV cache miss rate jump to 72%, and runtime restart count +3 across affected hosts.
steps_to_reproduce: Trigger deterministic edge cache eviction on hot prefixes for a tenant with sharded model placement.
Issue concurrent mixed-size generate requests that fan-out across shards immediately after eviction.
Monitor api-gateway 5xx rate and serving-runtime model load times.
logs: [2026-03-13T11:06:12Z] api-gateway: upstream returned 502 for /v1/generate tenant=veridian-prod request_id=abc123
[2026-03-13T11:06:13Z] runtime-host-17: model-manager: starting shard reload (shard_count=4) duration=2480ms
[2026-03-13T11:06:14Z] runtime-host-12: OOM while allocating kv-cache page -> process restart
[2026-03-13T11:06:15Z] scheduler: lease reacquire delay=1.2s due to model-manager lock contention
investigation_notes: Initial triage: spike coincides with scheduled edge-cache invalidation job (edge-cache/evict-hot-prefixes) that ran at 11:05 UTC.
Metric correlation: KV cache miss rate and model load latency tightly correlated with api-gateway 5xx curve (see dashboard link).

Hypothesis: Evictions caused many requests to trigger shard reloads simultaneously; model-manager serializes shard loads per-host leading to head-of-line blocking, retry amplification, and eventual runtime OOM on some hosts.
Observed backpressure pattern: api-gateway retries + client hedging amplified fan-out to the serving-runtime, increasing concurrent load above reserved capacity for Dedicated pool D-12.
comments: Support (Aisha Patel) 2026-03-13T11:30Z: Customer reporting sustained errors, opened incident. Collected initial logs and dashboards. Escalating to SRE and runtime team.
SRE (Diego Morales) 2026-03-13T12:02Z: Identified edge-cache job ID 2026-03-13-evict-042; paused further cache invalidations and reduced route weight to affected hosts.

Runtime eng (Maya Chen) 2026-03-13T12:25Z: Confirmed serialized shard reloads and model-manager lock queue growing. Proposed mitigation: stagger shard initialization and add soft timeouts on reload path.
Support (Aisha Patel) 2026-03-13T12:45Z: Informed customer of temporary mitigation: paused eviction job and enabled fallback to model replica variant; errors reduced to baseline.
Customer (VeridianAI - ops@veridian.ai) 2026-03-13T13:10Z: Verified service quality improved after mitigation; requesting root-cause and permanent fix ETA.
temporary_workaround: Paused edge-cache eviction job for veridian-prod until fix is deployed.
Applied runtime route weight shift away from hosts performing cold reloads to healthy replicas.
Enabled model replica fallback variant for the tenant to avoid cross-shard fanout during recovery.
resolution: Deployed runtime patch v2.14.1 that staggers shard reloads across hosts and relaxes model-manager global lock during high-load recovery.
Updated edge-cache eviction job to perform randomized stagger windows (5-15s) per prefix to avoid coordinated invalidations.
Added alerting on concurrent shard reloads > 3 and increased autoscale buffer for Dedicated pools by +10% during model reload windows.
resolution_notes: Patch rollout completed 2026-03-14 02:10 UTC, monitored for 24h with no recurrence on veridian-prod.
Follow-up action: schedule a runbook update to include 'pause eviction' step and add a pre-check that aborts large-scale evictions when concurrent reloads detected.
Customer success: scheduled post-incident review with VeridianAI for 2026-03-16 to review mitigation and SLAs.
next_steps: Create INT ticket to refactor model-manager locking strategy to finer-grained shard locks (owner: runtime team).
Add precondition to edge eviction job to query active model reloads via scheduler API; abort when > threshold.
Customer follow-up call and delivery of postmortem and remediation timeline.
